fixture_identity: All benches/, examples/, Cargo.lock and promoted_slow_offenders.txt blobs match between the two revisions. Both were built sequentially in the same checkout and target paths.

pilot.interpretation: Short screening runs; follow up positive deltas and apparent improvements with longer repeated pairs. Do not interpret this as established parity.

source_size_note: Shared src/verified files contain both executable Rust and ghost proofs; other production files still include inline test code. Categories are physical source counts, not an estimate of erased runtime code.

candidate_validation_summary.scope: 598f059; add6365 adds one separately validated regression test and corrects only the fuzz harness

baseline_test_failure: Untouched baseline lacks exact_quadratic_normal_form in the no-GMP-analog API inventory; default/all-target and coverage runs stop at that assertion. Supplementary default/all-feature all-target and complete coverage matrices PASS with only that classification entry added. Production sources and benchmark fixtures remain unchanged; original failure logs and the exact test-only patch are preserved.

fuzz.finding: Both revisions return a legitimate unknown for root_8(1/92)^8 - 1/92 at -512 precision. A derived maximum certificate depth of 730 bits supports the corrected -1024 harness request. The five-byte seed and degree/denominator/nonzero controls are committed in add6365. Each corrected run completed 2727 sanitizer executions over 2575 saved corpus files.
fuzz.sanitizer_limitation: AddressSanitizer retained. LeakSanitizer failed under ptrace; diagnostic logs preserved before retrying with detect_leaks=0.

saved_corpora.note: The real_elementary corrected-harness runs already replayed all 2575 frozen inputs; the other five targets subsequently replayed the full frozen corpora. All twelve final per-revision/target replay results passed with AddressSanitizer enabled and LeakSanitizer disabled only after its ptrace diagnostic.

baseline_supplementary_validation.classification: Supplementary baseline with only the missing no-GMP-analog inventory entry; original failures retained separately

expanded_runtime_source_note: Same nightly compiler, no-default-feature macro-expanded library, with cfg(test) and ghost annotations erased. Includes compiler-generated derives, imports and declarations; reports both total lines and tokei code lines. This is an auxiliary source-size view, not emitted machine-code size.

complete_criterion_screen.interpretation: One short pair per suite. Individual run confidence intervals only identify follow-up candidates; they are not a confidence interval for a repeated-pair effect. External comparator rows are preserved too.

timing_interpretation: The complete screen measures 1449 matching cases across nine suites, including two adversarial_library rows omitted by that harness from --list.
The 298 positive nonoverlapping within-run interval flags are triage signals, not independently established regressions. Unchanged Euclidean reference rows also showed large initial shifts.
Longer repeats use one-second warmup, three-second measurement, 50 samples and 100000 resamples. All timing uses CPU 2 and no overlapping qualification build, test or profiler.
Four matched-path pairs additionally use identical executable, working-directory, environment and Criterion output paths for each variant; copied executable hashes are checked.

The matched-path median pair changes include pi_pow cloning +3.88%, cached tan_pi export +9.78% with substantial variability, fixed-512 reduction -20.33%, large Knuth reduction +0.11%, and GMP hyperreal multiplication +0.03%. These do not establish equivalence or cause.

The cloning signal persists across all seven longer pairs and requires investigation. The cached conversion and remaining screen flags are unresolved; uncontrolled host activity, frequency, thermal state and ASLR limit inference.

representation_diagnostics.interpretation: Three inspected Real::clone instruction sequences match after normalizing addresses; this does not establish identity of the entire called graph or machine layout. An auxiliary executable using the same public constructors has identical instruction-count slopes for 1000 versus 10000 clones/exports on both revisions. These count profiles were separate from native timing. Initial startup instruction totals differ by 64 to 72 instructions. Native benchmark slowdowns remain unresolved; equal counts do not establish equal cycle cost.
